items.title: The Truth About Grape/Raisin Toxicity
items.script: Never let your dog eat grapes or raisins! These innocent fruits cause acute kidney failure. Even a tiny amount is deadly. Keep all grapes stored safely!
items.unique_fact: Grapes and raisins are highly toxic to dogs, causing kidney failure.
